exclude_selectors drops entire subtree unlike strip_tags which keeps children

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<body><div class=\"wrapper\"><p>Inner paragraph</p></div><p>Outer text</p></body>", "{\"exclude_selectors\":[\".wrapper\"]}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
